title: WashU EM Daily Intelligence Briefing, October 20, 2026
run_note: Shakedown run, fired manually; charter rev 8 read OK; all seven lanes complete.
bluf: Posture is Normal. Nothing in the last 24 hours threatens life safety or campus operations: no NWS product covers St. Louis, Ring 1 recorded no violent incident on reachable sources, no health advisory or hospital diversion is posted, and no outage touches a WashU asset. Four items need a routine decision today, led by the State Department raising Kenya to Level 3 on Oct 19 for Ebola risk. The Medical Campus has degraded street and transit access through Oct 31 that stacks against five evening events at Enterprise Center this week. The week is dry and mild and the load builds Friday through Sunday.
